# Shipping Delays

## Standard delivery windows

Standard shipping is quoted as 5-8 business days from order confirmation;
expedited shipping is 2-3 business days. These windows start when the
order ships, not when it's placed - fulfillment itself takes up to 2
business days before the carrier tracking number is even generated.

## When a package looks stuck

If tracking hasn't updated in 5+ business days and the last scan is not
"delivered," this is a carrier delay, not a lost package, in the first
10 business days past the quoted window. Advise the customer to wait; Acme
does not open a carrier trace before the 10-business-day mark because the
large majority of these resolve on their own once the carrier catches up
on a regional backlog.

## After 10 business days past the window

Once a shipment is more than 10 business days past its quoted delivery
window with no tracking movement, open a carrier trace and offer the
customer a choice: wait for the trace (typically 5-7 more business days)
or have Acme ship a free replacement immediately while the trace runs in
parallel. If the original arrives after a replacement was sent, the
customer is not charged for the extra unit - it's the cost Acme accepts to
avoid making the customer wait twice.

## Address issues

A shipment returned to Acme as undeliverable due to a bad address is not a
"delay" for the purposes of this policy - re-ship at customer expense once
the correct address is confirmed, no free replacement applies.
